payload.claim: The acceptance criterion for refusals requires that 'The line it prints names the pull request number' in all seven refusal cases, and 'for a url mismatch both urls' in addition. The url-mismatch branch (`if carried_url and carried_url != adopted_url:`) prints only `f"adopt: {args.spec_id}'s newest task already carries {carried_url}, not {adopted_url}"` — it never includes `args.pr`. Every other refusal line (missing-field at 2853, branch mismatch at 2857-2859) does include `{args.pr}`; this one does not. The witness `tests/test_cli.py::test_adopt_refuses_a_pull_request_gh_cannot_describe_or_whose_head_is_another_branch` only asserts `carried_url in out` and `different_url in out` for this case and never asserts the pull request number appears, so it passes regardless of whether the number is printed.
